<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one signal falls in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10‑30 ppm): a peak at 26.41 ppm. The other aliphatic carbons appear at higher chemical shifts (≈36‑38 ppm), which correspond to methylene or tertiary carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl group.</thought>
